energy_zero: DFT Fermi level; each channel shifted by (DFT midgap of the channel - E_F); 0 for a metal (already at E_F)
spinor_basis: 2n functions: orbitals 1..n spin up, n+1..2n spin down; up-down blocks zero

native_spin.note: energy_offset_eV: native EHT energy minus huckel-SP.dat energy (per channel, states within 3 eV of E_F); fitted_tables: the two tables as fitted, whose absolute energies differ by an arbitrary constant (common Fermi level not physical); aligned_tables: Hii of each channel shifted (delta_Hii_up_eV, delta_Hii_down_eV) so both channels put the DFT Fermi level at the same EHT energy (yaehmop_spin/up.dat, down.dat); max_deviation_*: change of band shape against huckel-SP.dat
